name: faq
description: FAQ band — a section holding a heading and the accordion, so the questions sit in the page column like every other band. (The faq block was merely a data-shaped accordion; on the help page the repeater had won in practice.)
provenPattern: A pure arrangement with no state or behaviour of its own, so it is a composition rather than a block (arrangement-only → template).

knowledge.purpose: A frequently-asked-questions section: an h2 heading over the accordion
useCases: Handling objections after the pricing band
Removing hesitation before the sign-up form
antiPatterns: Starting with every question open — the accordion's job is to shorten the page
More than ten questions — the list becomes a scanning load; split by topic
Writing the question as a heading and the answer like a heading too — the hierarchy is lost
Items without an id — the accordion keys open/closed by id; give every question its own
Adding a second heading above the band — the band carries its own h2 in {{HEADING}}

mobileCollapse: Already one column: the heading, then each question as a full-width row that opens in place.

placeholders.{{HEADING}}: the band heading (h2), e.g. "Frequently asked questions" or a topic ("Billing questions")
placeholders.{{FAQ_ITEMS}}: accordion.props.items — [{id, title, content}]: id is a short unique key per question (e.g. q-refunds) — the accordion opens and closes items by it, so an item without one cannot be opened; title is the question, content the answer
